summary: First-pass end-to-end testing of Back2U (React+FastAPI+MongoDB). Wrote 39 pytest cases covering auth/policy, items/ML/duplicates, matching, private-clue privacy, claims incl. rate limiting + score hiding, full QR + 6-digit code handover flow, watchlists, notifications, admin dashboard incl. ban/suspend+appeal overturn, locations CRUD, uploads validation. All 39 backend tests pass against the live preview URL. Smoke-tested frontend: home + nav, demo-login (alice welcome toast), browse/feed, 7 info pages (all 200), ProtectedRoute (student /admin -> home), admin login + dashboard tabs render (Overview, Misuse reports, Claims, Users, Handovers, Appeals, Items, Locations & categories, Audit log), mobile 390px layout clean with hamburger. No console errors on key pages. Seed data intact; created only TEST_ prefixed items/users; admin reinstated the TEST ban user via appeal flow.

issues: Items without image_paths render a broken-image icon placeholder; consider a neutral illustration/initials to avoid implying a broken asset

action_items: (Optional UX) Replace broken-image placeholder for photoless items on cards with a neutral icon
(Optional) Expose 'Submit a report' deep link routes (e.g. /report/found, /report/lost) if they aren't already, so users/testers can bookmark them
critical_code_review_comments: server.py uses deprecated @app.on_event('startup'/'shutdown') — FastAPI recommends lifespan context manager (future compatibility)
login brute-force lockout key uses request.client.host which is often the proxy IP in k8s; consider X-Forwarded-For to prevent one noisy IP from locking the whole class

CORS_ORIGINS='*' combined with allow_credentials=True is accepted by FastAPI/Starlette but browsers block credentialed requests to a wildcard origin; explicit origin list is safer (works today only because frontend sends Authorization header, not cookies cross-site)
parse_dt is imported inside compute_stats() loop (routes_misc.py line 215) — move to module level for clarity/perf
routes_items.recompute_matches O(N) scan of opposite-type items per report; acceptable at MVP scale but note for future

context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite at /app/backend/tests/test_back2u_e2e.py — run with `python -m pytest backend/tests/test_back2u_e2e.py -n 0 --junitxml=/app/test_reports/pytest/pytest_results.xml`. pytest.ini forces -n 2 --dist loadscope which breaks session-scoped fixtures across workers; use -n 0 for serial. Several TEST_ items/claims/receipts exist from this run — safe to leave or purge by prefix. Frontend report submission wizard, duplicate dialog UI, matches panel UI, QR scanner UI (camera headless-unfriendly) were NOT exercised via Playwright — the underlying APIs are covered by pytest; main agent can self-test these via browser if needed.
rca of the issue: No product bugs found. Three initial test failures were test-only issues: (a) reason='test' violated min_length=5 so admin action returned 422 — fixed by using longer reason; (b) pytest-xdist's loadscope split test classes across workers so a session fixture that approved a claim ran only on one worker — rewrote the handover test to be self-contained; (c) private-clues privacy test incorrectly asserted secure_collection_location is hidden even to an approved claimant — by design this field IS revealed to approved claimants (routes_items.py get_item lines 265-268) and that is correct behaviour.
